## Engineering task

What inputs would the user give an agent, and what reviewable result should it produce? Include one concrete example.

## Current gap

Which existing skills were considered? What failure or missing behavior motivates this proposal?

## Layer and sources

Is this core, methodology, language/tool or visualization work? Identify authoritative sources, exact editions/revisions and access or licensing restrictions where known.

## Acceptance and evaluation

Describe expected artifacts, failure cases, a baseline/assisted task and how someone could verify the result. State unknowns and tool requirements without treating them as settled.
